versions.changelog:
field-research v1.0.0

- Initial release of the skill for bilingual literature search.
- Supports input of Chinese keywords to generate both Chinese and English keywords with academic translations.
- Searches recent 10-year literature results from CNKI (Chinese) and Google Scholar (English), prioritizing browser-based manual verification.
- Outputs results in a fixed, standard Markdown table with strict field requirements and descending year order.
- Implements robust pause-and-wait workflow for CAPTCHAs, requiring user intervention before proceeding.
- Ensures integrity by not fabricating any data; leaves fields empty or marked when unverifiable.
